comments:
The item was located in the Tibetan Library of the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing by van der Kuijp, who mentioned it in [KM47ZZDJ]: 665, n. 108, initially attributing the work to rMa bya (ID:3842).
The manuscript is being edited by Yozhimizu et al. see ([Q5TFQTM8], [N8VI2328] for fols. 1-40b5 (ID:5527)), and [CMTPPRKW]: 15-28 for fols. 73a9-77a3.
